environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in us-east-1 VPC. Application Load Balancer forwards HTTP traffic on port 443 to target group on port 8080. ALB listener uses standard TLS termination with ACM certificate. No authentication layer configured on ALB. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Task role has basic CloudWatch Logs permissions. No WAF attached to ALB.
